project.name: Hospital wing with imaging suite
project.description: Synthetic three-storey hospital wing: concrete frame, glazed south facade, dense MEP and an imaging suite on the ground floor.

phases.name: Mobilise
phases.description: Survey control and infection-control (ICRA) barrier set-up next to the live hospital.

phases.name: Substructure
phases.description: Excavation, piles, footings, ground slab and underground drainage.

phases.name: Superstructure
phases.description: Concrete frame, floor slabs with strike lag, cores and roof steel.

phases.name: Envelope
phases.description: External walls, curtain wall, windows and roof, closed in before services.

phases.name: MEP rough-in
phases.description: Partition framing, ducts, pipes, medical gas, sprinklers, trays, plant and electrical gear.

phases.name: Interiors
phases.description: Boarding, ceiling close-out, floors, doors and lead-lined walls.

phases.name: MEP finish
phases.description: Diffusers, light fittings, devices and plumbing fixtures.

phases.name: Medical equipment
phases.description: MRI, CT, sterilisers and fixed clinical equipment built into finished rooms.

phases.name: Commissioning
phases.description: Air balance, pressure tests, fire alarm, power and medical gas certification.

phases.name: ICRA close-out
phases.description: HEPA clean and infection control sign-off before barriers come down.

steps.name: Erect ICRA barrier and negative air
steps.description: Dust containment barrier with negative air next to the live hospital. Every dusty or noisy step in an occupied_adjacent zone waits for it.

steps.name: Lay underground drainage and service ducts
Fix slab reinforcement and services sleeves
Strike formwork
steps.description: Formwork can only be struck 7 days after the pour. Finishing and services work in the storey below waits for the strike above it.

steps.name: Build external wall and cladding
steps.description: External walls only start once the slab above is in place.

steps.name: Install roof deck, insulation and membrane
Frame partition walls
steps.description: Stud framing; track cutting and anchor drilling make dust, so ICRA applies.

steps.name: Set air handling unit or plant item
Install water, waste and heating pipe
Medical gas pressure test and purge
steps.description: Hold point: walls cannot be boarded and equipment cannot be installed until this passes.

steps.name: Fire-stop penetrations
steps.description: Fire-stopping of every wall penetration; inspected before the wall can be closed.

steps.name: Set transformer
steps.description: Longest lead item of the building services: 40 weeks.

steps.name: Board, tape and finish partition walls
Close ceiling
steps.description: Only after every service above the ceiling in the cell is installed and inspected.

steps.name: Install MRI scanner
steps.description: 26 week lead. Room must be shielded, floored and gas-tested before the magnet arrives.

steps.name: Install fixed clinical equipment
steps.description: Bed-heads, theatre lights, pendants, nurse-call and similar.

steps.name: Test and balance air system
steps.description: Air balancing must finish before the room can be handed over.

steps.name: Fire alarm and sprinkler acceptance test
Medical gas certification
steps.description: Third-party verification of purity, flow and alarms for every outlet.

steps.name: Room-by-room handover documentation
steps.description: Air balance, medical gas certificate and fire test must all be signed off first.

steps.name: Install miscellaneous element
steps.description: Default step for any element no rule matched. Shows up in the authoring feedback list.

steps.name: Survey set-out of the work area
Temporary works design check and permit to load
Hot work permit and fire watch

gates.name: Foundations before frame
gates.description: Piles tested, footings and ground slab inspected and drains proven on the storey before columns go up.

gates.name: Weathertight before MEP rough-in
gates.description: Frame inspected and envelope closed on the storey before any services go in.

gates.name: Ceiling close-out gate
gates.description: Every rough-in inspection in the zone passed before boarding and ceilings close the services in.

gates.name: Rooms ready for clinical equipment
gates.description: Medical gas pressure test passed in the zone before any medical equipment is installed.

gates.name: Strict commissioning gate
gates.description: Pressure tests, air balance, fire test and medical gas certification complete before ICRA barriers come down.

gates.name: ICRA sign-off before handover
gates.description: Infection control clearance for every occupied-adjacent zone before documents are issued.

sequence_cards.name: Operating room recipe
sequence_cards.description: Frame, rough-in, fire-stop and gas test, lead lining, ceilings, hygienic floors, fixtures, equipment, pressure test and commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Imaging suite recipe
sequence_cards.description: MRI and CT rooms: shielded walls, services, floors, then the long-lead scanner install before commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Plant room recipe
sequence_cards.description: Plant set first, then pipework, ductwork and electrical, tests, enclosing finishes and commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Ward floor recipe
sequence_cards.description: Generic repeating recipe for ward, corridor and clinic zones.

scenario.name: Hospital Wing: Standard
scenario.description: A multi-storey wing with imaging suite, theatres and sterile services next to a live ward. Balanced crews and cash.

events.name: Wet week
events.text: Heavy rain. Slab pours, roofing and curtain wall work slow down.

events.name: Hospital asks for quiet hours
events.text: The ward manager asks for no noisy work near the live ward during treatment hours.

choices.label: Shift noisy work to evenings and nights

events.name: Infection control audit
events.text: The hospital audits dust control next to the ward. A missing barrier stops the zone.

events.name: Dust complaint from the ward
events.text: Dust is detected on the corridor side of the barrier.

choices.label: Hire HEPA scrubbers for the zone
Stop dusty work for a week and re-seal

events.name: MRI magnet delayed
events.text: The magnet factory reports a cryostat issue. Delivery may slip.

events.name: Transformer delayed at factory
events.text: The 40 week transformer misses its test slot.

events.name: Clash in the ceiling void
events.text: Ducts, pipes and trays collide above the corridor. RFI raised.

events.name: Medical gas test fails
events.text: A leak is found at a brazed joint. Re-braze and re-test.

events.name: Inspector backlog
events.text: The building inspector is booked solid. Hold points take longer.

events.name: High wind: tower crane stopped
events.text: Gusts above the crane limit. Heavy lifts are stood down.

events.name: Live cable struck
events.text: The excavator nicks a hospital feeder. A brief power flicker on the ward and an incident report.

events.name: Vendor engineers delayed
events.text: The scanner vendor engineers are held up on another hospital.

events.name: Safety stand-down
events.text: Trade stacking causes a near miss. The zone stands down for a toolbox talk.

events.name: Cold snap
events.text: Overnight frost delays pours and external work.

events.name: Client advance on equipment
events.text: The health trust releases an advance for long-lead equipment.

recipes.name: ICRA containment lifecycle
recipes.summary: Permit, erect the barrier with negative air, verify it, work behind it, HEPA clean, clear and remove it.

steps.note: ICRA permit with risk class and mitigation
Barrier, negative air, sticky mat, signage
Smoke test and pressure differential check
After the dusty work
Clearance, then barrier removal

logic.reason: Dusty work happens between these two steps and is not part of the recipe

checks: Daily barrier and pressure checks while dusty work runs
references: Infection prevention and control guidance for construction and renovation in healthcare facilities (ICRA)

recipes.name: CT suite
recipes.summary: Lead-lined room, services, floor, crane or trolley delivery, vendor installation and calibration, radiation checks, clean and handover. CT has a 20 week lead.

steps.note: Route and weight check for the gantry
Lead lining to the radiation physicist specification
Radiation survey and interlock test
Calibration and acceptance tests

checks: Shielding verified by a radiation survey
references: Manufacturer installation and site planning manuals for the equipment
Infection prevention and control guidance for construction and renovation in healthcare facilities (ICRA)
Radiation protection guidance for diagnostic imaging rooms

recipes.name: MRI suite
recipes.summary: Shielded room first, services and RF cage, floor, crane lift of the magnet, vendor shimming, power and air checks, clean and hand over. The MRI has a 26 week lead.

steps.note: Quench pipe route and magnet delivery permit
Route, door opening and rigging plan
Magnet plinth and floor loading check
RF and magnetic shielding as the vendor specifies
Non-magnetic materials only
Wall opening left until the magnet is in
Ramp-up, shimming, image quality tests

logic.reason: Route and rigging plan before delivery

checks: No ferrous materials near the magnet area
references: Manufacturer installation and site planning manuals for the equipment
National lifting operations guidance (lift planning and appointed person duties)
Infection prevention and control guidance for construction and renovation in healthcare facilities (ICRA)

recipes.name: Live hospital tie-in during a shutdown window
recipes.summary: Permit and locate, set ICRA, plan the isolation, hot work permit, make the tie-in with test, restore and verify before handback.

steps.note: Clinical risk assessment and isolation plan
Prefabricate before the window; connect during the window
Valves and tie-in fittings
Pressure test of the new connection before reinstatement

logic.reason: No tie-in without an approved window

checks: Prefabrication complete before the window opens
Restoration verified with the clinical team
references: Infection prevention and control guidance for construction and renovation in healthcare facilities (ICRA)
Healthcare estates guidance for planned shutdowns and tie-ins

recipes.name: Medical gas pipeline system
recipes.summary: Hot work permit, install pipework, pressure test and purge, fire-stop and close walls, install outlets, third-party certification and handover.

steps.note: Brazing with oxygen-free nitrogen purge
Standing pressure, leak and cross-connection tests
Walls closed only after the test
Alarm panel and area valve checks
Terminal units, alarms and pendants
Independent verification of identity, flow and purity

logic.reason: No wall closure before the pressure test
Equipment connects to a tested system only

checks: Pressure, leak and cross-connection tests witnessed
references: Medical gas pipeline system guidance (design, installation, testing and verification)
Fire safety guidance for healthcare buildings (compartmentation and fire-stopping)

recipes.name: Operating room fit-out
recipes.summary: Build an operating room as a repeating recipe: ICRA, framing, services, gas test, fire-stopping, sealed boarding and ceilings, hygienic floor, theatre fixtures, air balance, pressure test, clean and handover.

steps.note: Brazing of medical gas pipework
Sealed, smooth walls
Sealed hygienic ceiling
Welded, coved flooring
HEPA terminals
Pendants and theatre lights

logic.reason: Walls cannot close over untested gas pipe

checks: ICRA barrier verified before dusty work
Medical gas pressure test before wall closure
Air balance and pressure regime test before clean
references: Infection prevention and control guidance for construction and renovation in healthcare facilities (ICRA)
Medical gas pipeline system guidance (design, installation, testing and verification)
Healthcare ventilation guidance (air change rates, pressure regimes, validation)
Fire safety guidance for healthcare buildings (compartmentation and fire-stopping)

recipes.summary: Isolate and permit, plan the lift, set the AHU on its pad, connect ducts and cables, vendor commissioning, air balance and power energisation, with ICRA around the work.

steps.note: Isolation, shutdown window and clinical risk assessment
Route, crane position and quiet-hours window

logic.reason: Lift plan approved before the unit moves
No tie-in without the shutdown window

checks: Clinical sign-off of the shutdown window
Air balance and pressure regime restored before handback
references: Manufacturer installation and site planning manuals for the equipment

Chemical-resistant floor with falls
